items.title: Diesel Price Hits Record High. An Export Ban Is on the Table.
items.summary: Record prices for diesel fuel are starting to hit Americans hard, and they’re even weighing on stock prices.  The surge in diesel is hitting the profits of farmers and trucking companies, and causing severe sticker shock to consumers who use oil for heating.
